description: GTA 5 vs GTA 6 realism side-by-side, 4 beats (TikTok 'GTA 5 vs GTA 6' format). Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-vs5/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-vs5.mp4), a PRE-STACKED 1920x2160 30 fps video: top half = GTA 5 gameplay (muted, from YouTube), bottom half = Windah's GTA VI stream (facecam baked in; Windah's audio is the only audio). Beats (source time, GTA 5 | GTA 6): MAKAN DAN MINUM 0-6.5 = Franklin drinks a soda at a vending machine (GTA 5 Video Gaming Source, 1-Poqm6iJvo 15.6-22.1) | Lucia eats a taco, stream-2132-2224.mp4 t 2916.4-2922.9 (live4 'GAMEPLAY #4'; 'Gila real banget, hidup banget men, realistis banget cuy'); AIR DAN OMBAK 6.5-13.1 = sailing yacht in rough seas (Notorious Gamer, eEdRkjnQ7yw at 0:53.6-1:00.2) | boat wake, stream-1832-1932.mp4 t 380.4-387.0 ('udah ada radionya guys... masih bilang garing ya'); MEDITASI DAN YOGA 13.1-19.4 = Michael's yoga (Aejax88, -RSbKKKSm7Y 6:26.8-6:30.4 + 6:35.0-6:37.7, 720p60) | Jason meditating, stream-2215-2315.mp4 (live3 'GAMEPLAY #3') t 2786.9-2790.5 + 2793.5-2796.2 ('gila ada mekanik... mekanik meditasi guys'); OLAHRAGA 19.4-25.92 = GTA Online mansion gym chin-up bar (Captain, 7LOgkME7p0c 2:06-2:12.5) | pull-ups, stream-1832-1932.mp4 t 88.1-94.6 ('gila 12 buat cowok sih GG ya'). Dropped: TABRAKAN (no clean real-time vanilla GTA 5 crash found; the GTA 6 crash also has bodies just before 2926) and POLISI (GTA 5 has no vanilla traffic stop, only LSPDFR mod footage). Layout: Ink bg, hook Audex 66 line 1 Paper 'GTA VI VS GTA V' (Audex draws 5 like S, so roman numerals), line 2 Volt 'BEDANYA GILA BANGET' bottom-anchored at y266; two 1080x520 panels (crop 1920x1000 of each 1080p half, 40 px off top and bottom) GTA 5 y285-805, GTA 6 y865-1385, corner labels 'GTA V' Paper / 'GTA VI' Volt, beat label in the 60 px gap, Windah subs Audex 62 Volt over the GTA 6 panel at y1085; campaign banner (y1417-1596) stays clear. Main 25.92 s + 4.0 s outro. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Source built with a scratch script (per-beat vstack, crf 15, 30 fps, afade 0.04/0.1 per beat).
